summary: All retained six-cell input, request, pager, logical-path, compile-domain, resource, timing, cost and sampled GPU-boundary evidence is internally consistent with the frozen one-cohort descriptive result.
repository_state_observed: shared dirty worktree; frozen manifests and readback payloads used

ground_truth_provenance.details: This is direct runtime timing and transfer measurement; no task ground truth or synthetic accuracy label is used. The prior numerical qualification is inherited only as a bounded invocation-domain gate.

score_normalization.details: No normalized composite score is used. Primary capture, request/token metrics, bytes and process wall are reported in their raw units with direct ratios.

result_existence.details: All 1470 readback payload entries rehash and all six retained cells are COMPLETE with return code zero.

call_path.details: Each pager record reaches one top-level fused_experts invocation. Y performs exactly one logical alignment helper per top-level call and invokes the original fused function once; F/X retain the original path.

switch_and_restoration.details: Both Y cells record assignment restoration after initialization, warmup and measurement and final hook restoration. F/X have logical alignment disabled and empty logical phase records.

no_double_execution.details: Reference, prefix, numerical readback, negative-control, kernel-validation and CPU/runtime observers are disabled or empty. Y calls, completed calls and helper calls are equal in every phase.

compile_domain.details: Every cell completes all 320 declared M1..160 x two-GEMM compile-and-load-only calls with unchanged pager/KV state. All measurement rows are in domain and all six measurement jit event sets are empty. Coverage applies only to this MoE Triton family.

request_and_token_denominators.details: Each cell has 16 completed requests, 512 one-token output events, 56 scheduler steps, 2544 scheduled token positions, 896 measurement pager calls and 40704 layer-token rows.

metric_reconstruction.details: TTFT, TPOT, maximum ITL, completion and complete capture were independently rebuilt from raw request/event timestamps and agree with the retained analyzer values to serialization tolerance.

statistical_scope.details: Requests same engines/arrival episode are not treated as independent samples; two engines per arm are not a noise floor or significance estimate.

resource_parity.details: All arms record 384 physical expert slots, 4831838208 expert bytes and 1073741824 KV bytes. X/Y both use oneshot 336-private plus 48-stage slots.

gpu_boundary.details: Expected UUID, cooperative group flock, outer pre-cell and three inner per-cell samples all pass without a foreign PID. Sampling does not prove continuous exclusion of an uncooperative process.

cost_accounting.details: Capture and full subprocess wall are kept separate. Startup, compile preparation, warmup, finalization, artifact I/O and shutdown remain in subprocess wall; nested timing spans are not summed into wall.

trajectory_boundary.details: Same-arm outputs/routes are identical, while cross-arm routes differ and only 13/16 F-Y and 14/16 X-Y request outputs match per block. This does not invalidate policy-specific request timing, but it prevents task-quality/equivalence and trajectory-invariant causal claims.

strongest_baseline: F for completion, with X retained as the same-budget original-alignment control
next_smallest_experiment: Run the frozen independent new workload cohort using the same six-engine mirrored design and unchanged accounting; do not threshold-tune or infer a noise floor from this cohort.
trace_note: No .aris trace was created because the repository-specific instruction for this audit forbids unrequested .aris artifacts.
